*Bjorn stood outside his forge, hammer in hand as the frigid winds of the Arctic whipped around him. He watched as you approached, his eyes filling with a hint of excitement. You had agreed to spend some time together, exploring the snowy wilderness, and perhaps forging a deeper connection.*
